    """
    获取 v2 在 v1 上的投影向量

    v1 = np.array(v1).reshape(3)

"""Generate a replayable place_empty_cup trajectory for the frozen instance."""
from pathlib import Path

from rcb_traj import Session


ROOT = Path("/app")
OUT = ROOT / "output"


def main():
    s = Session("place_empty_cup", instance=ROOT / "instance.json")
    env = s.env
    assert s.status()["state_sha"] == "cebe865d8ce1"

    arm = "left"
    cup = env.cup
    coaster = env.coaster
    print("cup", cup.get_pose().p, "coaster", coaster.get_pose().p)

    s.record_start()
    grasp = env.grasp_actor(
        cup,
        arm,
        pre_grasp_dis=0.10,
        grasp_dis=0.0,
    )
    print("grasp action prepared", grasp[0], len(grasp[1]))
    env.move(grasp)
    print("after grasp plan", env.plan_success, "cup", cup.get_pose().p)
    if not env.plan_success:
        raise RuntimeError("cup grasp plan failed")

    target = coaster.get_functional_point(0, "pose")
    place = env.place_actor(
        cup,
        arm,
        target,
        functional_point_id=0,
        pre_dis=0.02,
        dis=0.005,
        is_open=True,
        constrain="free",
    )
    print("place action prepared", place[0], len(place[1]))
    env.move(place)
    print("after place plan", env.plan_success, "cup", cup.get_pose().p)
    if not env.plan_success:
        raise RuntimeError("cup placement plan failed")

    # Let the released cup settle onto the coaster, with both grippers open.
    env.delay(1)
    actions = s.record_stop()
    print("recorded", actions.shape, "success", env.check_success())
    print("cup fp", cup.get_functional_point(0, "pose").p)
    print("coaster fp", coaster.get_functional_point(0, "pose").p)

    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    s.save_trajectory(actions, OUT / "trajectory.npz", meta={"arm": arm})
    replay = s.replay(actions)
    print("replay", replay)
    if not replay["success"]:
        raise RuntimeError("recorded actions did not pass open-loop replay")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
